name: Tidemark
maturity: Pre-launch: built and unit-tested, running in Expo Go, no signed iPhone build and not on the App Store.

brand.tone: Plain-spoken, calm and candid: it explains what the app does and doesn't do, avoids hype and refuses to scold.

facts.text: Tidemark is an iPhone weight tracker that focuses on your trend rather than the day-to-day swings on the scale.

source.quote: **A weight tracker that shows the trend, not the noise.**

facts.text: Your weigh-ins, your trend and your plan live on your phone and nowhere else.

source.quote: Weigh-ins, the trend and your plan, on your phone and nowhere else.

facts.text: Tidemark is designed for people who are trying to lose weight and want a clearer read on their weigh-ins.

source.quote: what it does for someone trying to lose weight

facts.text: It also suits people who take a regular medication dose and want a simple record of when they took it.

source.quote: on a dose day, one tap marks the dose taken

facts.text: It is for people who would rather keep their health data on their own device, with no account to create.

source.quote: No account, no server, and nothing leaves the phone unless you send it.

facts.text: A bathroom scale gives one number a day, and that number can swing with salt, water, sleep or a late meal.

source.quote: that number swings by a kilo or more with salt, water, sleep and a late meal

facts.text: Seeing the number go up on a bad day, even when you are doing everything right, is when many people give up.

source.quote: sees it go *up* on a Tuesday and decides it isn't working. That is the day most

facts.text: Tidemark reads your numbers properly: a trend one odd day can't drag far, an honest weekly rate and a plan to hold it against.

source.quote: a trend that one odd day can't drag far, an honest weekly

facts.text: The target line is a guide, not a verdict, and nothing in the app scolds you.

source.quote: **The target line is a guide, not a verdict.** That sentence is the product.

facts.text: The trend uses Holt's linear smoothing, which follows the direction you're heading rather than trailing behind like a plain moving average.

source.quote: rather than trailing a week behind it the way a plain moving average does.

facts.text: When a weigh-in jumps, the Trend tab explains why that is normal.

source.quote: When a weigh-in jumps, the Trend tab explains why that's normal, and nothing

facts.text: Logging opens on your last weight with minus and plus steppers, so most weigh-ins take a tap or two.

source.quote: **Logging opens on your last weight**, with − and + steppers. Most weigh-ins

facts.text: Reminders never show a number, and the dose reminder doesn't even name the medication.

source.quote: The dose reminder doesn't even name the medication.

facts.text: The medication log records what you took and never suggests a dose or a change of dose; Tidemark is a record, not medical advice.

source.quote: **Tidemark is a record, not medical advice.** The medication log never suggests

facts.text: You can export a backup or CSV to wherever you choose, and backups can be locked with a password.

source.quote: A file you choose where to put. Backups can be locked with a password

facts.text: Every restore takes a snapshot first, and the snapshot is kept for 30 days in case you need it.

source.quote: The snapshot taken before the restore is kept for 30 days

facts.text: Tidemark treats its 'Data Not Collected' privacy label as a commitment: it holds only while nothing in the app sends data anywhere.

source.quote: **"Data Not Collected" is a commitment, not a description.** It stays true

facts.text: Buying Plus sends nothing of yours, and there are no analytics, ads, crash SDKs or accounts.

source.quote: buying Plus sends nothing of yours; there are no analytics, ads, crash SDKs or accounts

facts.text: Tidemark is free to download and the whole core is free; Tidemark Plus adds optional extras.

facts.text: For the first 90 days there is a launch offer: yearly Plus at £11.99 for the first year, then £19.99.

facts.text: Tidemark is built and tested but is not on the App Store yet; until launch the website says 'Coming soon to the App Store'.

facts.text: The web build is the owner's private test tool, not a product, and is not offered to anyone.

facts.text: The Tidemark website at tidemark.ysbdesigns.uk covers what the app does, Free and Plus, support questions and the privacy policy.

facts.text: The website has no waitlist or sign-up form, so it collects nothing from visitors.

facts.text: The yearly launch offer and the free trial cannot run at the same time; the one-week free trial on yearly Plus only starts after the launch offer ends.

source.quote: **The launch offer and the trial can't run at the same time.**

facts.text: Tidemark Plus includes the dose analysis and the doctor report.

source.quote: Plus includes the dose analysis and doctor report

facts.text: Nothing you enter in a Plus feature is lost if Plus lapses; it is hidden, kept, and comes back if you resubscribe.

source.quote: **Nothing entered in a Plus feature is lost when Plus lapses.**

facts.text: Weights are in kilograms by default, with stones and pounds for anyone who prefers them.

source.quote: kilograms first, with stones and pounds for anyone who chooses them.

facts.text: The App Store listing name is 'Tidemark: Weight Trend Tracker', while the Home Screen shows Tidemark.

facts.text: With no account, there is nothing to delete beyond the Delete all my data option in Settings.

source.quote: there's no account, so there's nothing to delete beyond Settings → Delete all my data.
